note: 26 sheets, 16 measured regions on 14 pages. Twelve rows are recorded - Figures 1-11 and Table 1 - and four regions are excluded: the (b) panel of the Figure 6 composite and the three appendix code listings. The paper actually prints 13 exhibits: Table 2 on p12 (2 columns, 3 data rows, caption "Table 2: AHP production", cited as "Table.2 shows the result of AHP") and Table 3 on p15 (3 columns, 13 data rows, caption "Table 3: Accurate placement of dams when n = 13 and Pf = 0.0024", cited on p16) have NO measured region and therefore cannot be recorded as rows - both are documented here and in CLAIMS. Table 2 is missed because it is a tiny 2x3 table between paragraphs whose three short hairlines are indistinguishable from the fraction bars of the two display equations above it; Table 3 is a three-rule 3x13 table in the lower half of p15 with no closing rules. The expected text-layer truncation "Pf = 0." for Table 3 is an artefact: the printed caption reads "Pf = 0.0024". Figure 6 is a composite of (a) a 2-D map and (b) a 3-D elevation plot with separate (a)/(b) subcaptions and one figure-level caption below both; the detector splits it into two regions at x = 297, so the (a) panel is the row and the (b) panel is excluded as its fragment. Captions sit above for all three tables and below for all eleven figures. Figure 6's figure-level caption sits below both panels and outside BOTH measured regions; Figures 8 and 9 lose their caption's second line at the region edge while Figure 5 keeps it; Figure 2's symbol key (V, Ai) is a bulleted paragraph after the caption that the region does not contain. Only Figure 9 prints data labels, and its coordinate pairs reproduce Table 3 rounded. The appendix code listings are plain monospaced text with no frame; they are detected only because of the full-measure page and section rules.
rules: 表题与图题的编号只有一种写法：全文 3 个表格与 11 幅图形一律写成 "Table 1: Nomenclature"、"Figure 6: Zambezi River…" 这种「编号+冒号+空格」；而正文引用却一律写成 "Table.1"、"Figure.2"、"Figure.9"，编号前多一个点、编号后没有冒号，同一个对象在题注和正文里是两种记号 [caption.numbering]。
表格题注一律在表格上方（3/3），图形题注一律在图形下方（11/11），没有例外；Figure 6 是唯一有两级题注的图形，(a)(b) 各自带子题注，总题注在两者下方 [caption.position]。
图题经常跨行且第二行只有一个词或半句：Figure 8 的题注第二行就是单独的 "lower."，Figure 9 的题注把 "Each dam is labelled with its height." 拆到第二行，Figure 6 的题注跨三行，检测框因此常常只覆盖题注第一行 [caption.words]。
三个表格全部是三线式（顶线、表头线、底线，无竖线、无行分隔线），全文没有任何带框线的网格表；Table 1 与 Table 2 连单位列都没有，距离 d、流量 Q、长度 L、宽度 M、高度 h 全部是无量纲写法 [table.rule_style]。
Table 2 与 Table 3 都没有被版面检测捕获：Table 2 只有 2 列 3 行、位于页面下方两段正文之间，三条极短的细线与同页两次出现的公式分数线粗细长度相同，任何闭合框或最小尺寸判据都会把它丢掉；Table 3 虽在页面下半部独立成块，也同样未被测出 [table.header_rows]。

图例分布极不均匀：Figure 1、2、6、9、11 完全没有图例（地图既无图例也无比例尺、指北针），Figure 3 只有一个箭头图例项 "data flow"，而 Figure 7 把 22 项图例放在图上方三行、Figure 4 用 11 项、Figure 10 用 6 项、Figure 8 用 3 项、Figure 5 用 2 项；全篇没有任何颜色标尺 [geometry.legend]。
坐标轴单位混乱：Figure 5 的 x 轴只写 "x"、y 轴只写 "Altitude"，两者都没有单位；Figure 7 写成 "altitude/m" 与 "x/km"；Figure 9 干脆不画轴线刻度，只把高度和坐标数字直接写在图形里；Figure 11 的字号明显小于 Figure 10，图是缩放进来的 [geometry.shared_axes]。
只有 Figure 9 把数据值印在图上（13 个坝高加 13 组坐标对），而这些坐标对正是 p15 的 Table 3 去掉小数后的复写（表中 664.4 / 1084.55，图上写 664,1084）；其余 10 幅图一个数字标签都没有 [geometry.data_labels]。
正文引用常早于图形一页：Table 1 在 p5 被引用而印在 p6，Figure 2 在 p6 被引用而印在 p7，Figure 4 在 p9 被引用而印在 p10，Figure 6 在 p13 被引用而印在 p14，Figure 8 在 p15 被引用而印在 p16；只有 Figure 1 从未被正文点名 [mention.style]。
附录里三处被检测为区域的「图形」其实是 MATLAB 代码清单：没有边框、没有行号栏、没有底纹，唯一的绘图元素是整幅宽的页眉线与章节线，检测器把这两条线读成了框的上下边 [geometry.family]。

tables.note: The paper's only measured table and its only table with a variable count this large: 2 columns, a "Symbol | Definition" header row and 15 data rows (i, Xi, Series(X), Supply(Xi), Risk(Xi), Pf, Q(Xi;t), k(Xi), N, n, M, L, d, alpha, h(Xi)).
